style.name: Luxury typography
style.description: Luxury-oriented typography often uses expressive serifs, careful spacing, and a restrained supporting system to suggest refinement. The effect comes from proportion, art direction, and consistency rather than any single font or color.

fonts.heading: Bodoni Moda
fonts.rationale: Bodoni Moda provides dramatic stroke contrast at display sizes; a simple sans handles small labels and product details.

tips: Use display serifs at sizes that preserve fine strokes.
Adjust letter spacing for the actual text.
Let photography and material details support the type.
avoid: Assuming metallic color alone conveys quality.

recipe.composition: Treat large high-contrast type as the main image; maintain precise spacing and modest supporting controls.
recipe.motion: Use restrained, brief transitions; never delay navigation to imply prestige.
recipe.signature: Elegant display proportions, disciplined whitespace, and considered typographic detail.
